reply.text: {"route": "care", "say": "Hey, I'm glad you asked me this. At twelve, getting strong is a great goal, but the training that works is different from what grown-up lifters do, and it's best planned with a parent or a doctor or PE teacher in the loop. Talk to your parents about wanting to train, and ask them to help you find a supervised youth strength program at a school or gym. Being bigger than your friends right now isn't a sign you're behind. Everyone's body develops on its own schedule, and that will come."}
